title: DispenserPlacer
description: Dispenser now places blocks. Yes, right in front of it. No, this is not a joke.
body:
### What is this?
This data pack does exactly what Mojang should have added years ago. It teaches dispensers to finally place blocks. 

### How it works:
1. Put any solid block into a dispenser.
2. Give it a redstone signal.
3. The dispenser places the block right in front of its face. 

### Why do you need this?
* Build fully automatic bridges and custom world eaters.
* Create insane new automatic farms.
* Make vanilla players cry tears of joy.

No laggy mess, no spaghetti code. Just drop it in your world and enjoy.
